name: Visagar Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Visagar Financial Services Ltd is a Non Banking Financial Company involved in Investment & Financial activities.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of investing in securities of listed and unlisted companies. 
Its investment portfolio is diversified across  sectors viz., Financial Services, Education, Real Estate, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 52.5 days to 27.7 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.03% over last 3 years.
